verdict.rationale: Sakana Marlin is a paid SaaS research agent, so offering scoped API credentials is a fair question for this kind of product and the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions API keys, credential scoping or permission controls. Probes for an OpenAPI spec and llms.txt all returned 404, and the docs describe only card sign-up, credits and an autonomous web-based research workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
